name: Pulaski County, AR
findings: Pulaski County has 2,073 nonprofit organizations. 842 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 704 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Pulaski County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
